data_improvement.measurement_expansion: No additional outcome records: the uncapped frozen ChEMBL target snapshot was already exhausted and changing compatibility rules after outcome inspection is prohibited.
data_improvement.metadata_expansion: Retrieve full ChEMBL assay records for development-only assay IDs and apply assay-protocol-rules-v1 literal extraction.
data_improvement.heldout_protocol_usage: Forbidden. Only protocol metadata attached to allowed historical measurements may form predictors.

estimand: Distribution of a comparable IC50 pChEMBL measurement for a previously measured compound in a previously unseen publication

m1.objective: Equal-publication weighted marginal Student-t negative log likelihood with the unseen-study random intercept integrated by Gauss-Hermite quadrature plus fixed Gaussian penalties

baselines.median_potency: Historical compound median with training-only Student-t residual scale
baselines.student_t_regression: Historical median plus a global correction and homoscedastic Student-t residual
baselines.xgboost: Prespecified shallow regularized XGBoost residual regressor using the same prediction-time features; uncertainty scale obtained from internal publication-grouped cross-fitted residuals
baselines.m0: Historical median plus global correction, homoscedastic Student-t residual, and unseen-study random intercept

validation.study_grouped: Leave one publication out; retrospective and explicitly not prospective
validation.forward_temporal: Train only on publications with strictly earlier years
validation.historical_same_compound_evidence: Allowed by estimand; held-out publication/activity/assay/outcome prohibited
validation.model_selection: No selection on quarantined cohorts; M1 and all ablations are prespecified

inference.support_rule: M1 must improve study-grouped and forward-temporal NLL over the strongest baseline with both publication-bootstrap 95% intervals excluding zero, without worse interval calibration or natural-product degradation.

amendments.stage: artifact QA before accepting final results
amendments.change: Set the numerical optimizer function-evaluation ceiling explicitly to 100000 and record optimizer messages.
amendments.reason: Two folds reached SciPy's implicit function-evaluation ceiling despite finite objectives. This is a convergence repair only; features, penalties, folds, predictions, metrics, and the support rule were not changed.
